description: Multi-layer data warehouse with bronze/silver/gold/mart layers, dimensional modeling, and aggregations
script:
// ============================================================
// COMPLEX LINEAGE EXAMPLE: Multi-Layer Data Warehouse
// Demonstrates: parallel flows, bronze/silver/gold stages,
//               dimensional modeling, fact tables
// ============================================================

// ========== CONFIGURATION & VARIABLES ==========
SET DateFormat='YYYY-MM-DD';
SET TimestampFormat='YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss';
LET vStartDate = '2024-01-01';
LET vEndDate = '2024-12-31';

// ========== SECTION ACCESS (RLS) ==========
Section Access;
LOAD *
INLINE [
    ACCESS, USERID, REGION
    ADMIN, ADMIN, *
    USER, JOHN_SMITH, NORTH
    USER, JANE_DOE, SOUTH
];
SECTION APPLICATION;

// ============================================================
// LAYER 1: BRONZE LAYER (Raw Data Ingestion)
// ============================================================

// ========== Raw Sales Transactions ==========
RawSales:
LOAD
    OrderID,
    OrderDate,
    CustomerID,
    ProductID,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice,
    SalesAmount,
    RegionCode,
    StoreID
FROM [data/sources/sales_transactions.csv]
(txt, codepage is 1252, embedded labels, delimiter is ',', msq);

// ========== Raw Customer Master Data ==========
RawCustomers:
LOAD
    CustomerID,
    CustomerName,
    Email,
    Phone,
    RegistrationDate,
    CustomerSegment,
    CreditLimit
FROM [data/sources/customers.xlsx]
(ooxml, embedded labels, table is Sheet1);

// ========== Raw Products Catalog ==========
RawProducts:
SQL SELECT 
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    CategoryID,
    CategoryName,
    SubCategoryID,
    SubCategoryName,
    UnitCost,
    ListPrice,
    SupplierID
FROM [ProductCatalog].[dbo].[Products] p
LEFT JOIN [ProductCatalog].[dbo].[Categories] c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID;

// ========== Raw Supplier Data ==========
RawSuppliers:
LOAD
    SupplierID,
    SupplierName,
    Country,
    PaymentTerms,
    LeadTime
FROM [data/sources/suppliers.xlsx]
(ooxml, embedded labels, table is Suppliers);

// ========== Raw Store Locations ==========
StoreLocations:
LOAD
    StoreID,
    StoreName,
    RegionCode,
    RegionName,
    CountryCode,
    CityName,
    OpenDate,
    ManagerID
FROM [data/sources/store_locations.csv]
(txt, codepage is 1252, embedded labels, delimiter is ',', msq);

// ============================================================
// LAYER 2: SILVER LAYER (Cleaned & Standardized)
// ============================================================

// ========== Cleaned Sales Facts ==========
SalesFacts:
LOAD
    OrderID & '-' & CustomerID & '-' & ProductID as SalesKey,
    OrderID,
    DATE(OrderDate) as OrderDate,
    CustomerID,
    ProductID,
    StoreID,
    TRIM(RegionCode) as RegionCode,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice,
    SalesAmount,
    SalesAmount * (1 + IF(Quantity > 100, 0.05, 0)) as AdjustedSalesAmount
RESIDENT RawSales
WHERE OrderDate >= '$(vStartDate)' AND OrderDate <= '$(vEndDate)';

// ========== Deduplicated Customers ==========
Customers:
LOAD DISTINCT
    CustomerID,
    TRIM(CustomerName) as CustomerName,
    LOWER(TRIM(Email)) as Email,
    TRIM(Phone) as Phone,
    DATE(RegistrationDate) as RegistrationDate,
    TRIM(CustomerSegment) as CustomerSegment,
    CreditLimit
RESIDENT RawCustomers;

// ========== Product Standardization ==========
Products:
LOAD
    ProductID,
    TRIM(ProductName) as ProductName,
    TRIM(CategoryName) as Category,
    UnitCost,
    ListPrice,
    ListPrice - UnitCost as GrossMargin
RESIDENT RawProducts;

// ============================================================
// LAYER 3: GOLD LAYER (Business Aggregations & KPIs)
// ============================================================

// ========== Monthly Sales Summary ==========
MonthlySummary:
LOAD
    YEAR(OrderDate) & '-' & MONTH(OrderDate) as YearMonth,
    YEAR(OrderDate) as Year,
    MONTH(OrderDate) as Month,
    RegionCode,
    SUM(SalesAmount) as TotalSales,
    SUM(Quantity) as TotalQuantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT OrderID) as OrderCount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) as CustomerCount,
    AVG(SalesAmount) as AvgOrderValue
RESIDENT SalesFacts
GROUP BY 
    YEAR(OrderDate),
    MONTH(OrderDate),
    RegionCode;

// ========== Customer Cohort Analysis ==========
CustomerMetrics:
LOAD
    CustomerID,
    CustomerSegment,
    MIN(OrderDate) as FirstOrderDate,
    MAX(OrderDate) as LastOrderDate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT OrderID) as TotalOrders,
    SUM(SalesAmount) as LifetimeSalesValue,
    AVG(SalesAmount) as AvgOrderValue
RESIDENT SalesFacts
GROUP BY CustomerID, CustomerSegment;

// ========== Product Performance ==========
ProductMetrics:
LOAD
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    Category,
    SUM(SalesAmount) as TotalRevenue,
    SUM(Quantity) as TotalQtySold,
    COUNT(DISTINCT OrderID) as OrdersContaining,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) as UniqueBuyers
RESIDENT SalesFacts
LEFT JOIN (Products) LOAD ProductID, ProductName, Category
GROUP BY ProductID, ProductName, Category;

// ========== Regional Performance Analysis ==========
RegionalAnalysis:
LOAD
    RegionCode,
    RegionName,
    SUM(SalesAmount) as RegionalSales,
    SUM(Quantity) as RegionalVolume,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) as RegionalCustomers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT StoreID) as StoreCount
RESIDENT SalesFacts
LEFT JOIN (Stores) LOAD RegionCode, RegionName, StoreID
GROUP BY RegionCode, RegionName;

// ============================================================
// LAYER 4: MART LAYER (Dimensional Star Schema)
// ============================================================

// ========== Fact Table: Sales ==========
FactSales:
CONCATENATE (SalesFacts)
LOAD
    SalesKey,
    OrderID,
    OrderDate,
    CustomerID,
    ProductID,
    StoreID,
    RegionCode,
    Quantity,
    UnitPrice,
    SalesAmount,
    AdjustedSalesAmount,
    'ACTUAL' as RecordType
RESIDENT SalesFacts;

// ============================================================
// EXPORT & STORAGE
// ============================================================

// Store processed data
STORE FactSales INTO [data/warehouse/fact_sales.qvd];
STORE MonthlySummary INTO [data/warehouse/monthly_summary.qvd];
STORE CustomerMetrics INTO [data/warehouse/customer_metrics.qvd];
STORE ProductMetrics INTO [data/warehouse/product_metrics.qvd];
STORE RegionalAnalysis INTO [data/warehouse/regional_analysis.qvd];
